# Zepto: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Look-back window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026
**Purpose:** Summarise material changes in news, launches, leadership, and deals before the 17 November meeting.

---

## Executive Summary

- **IPO timing has slipped again.** Zepto now plans to list between February and May 2027, after an earlier July 2026 target. The company says it will update its draft papers with newer financials ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).
- **A pre-IPO round is the bridge.** Zepto is reported to be raising about $105 million (₹1,000 crore) at a valuation of about $4.5 billion ([Mint/PTI, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/zepto-to-raise-rs-1-000-crore-in-pre-ipo-round-at-usd-4-5-billion-valuation-public-listing-delayed-11785430328994.html)). The company has confirmed a pre-IPO private placement but has not disclosed terms ([Moneycontrol News, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/zepto-announces-pre-ipo-private-placement-to-list-within-sebi-approved-timeline-13991005.html)).
- **Regulatory and compliance items surfaced in October.** These include a municipal fine in Bengaluru and a state-level licence action in Uttar Pradesh. The latter was not attributed to Zepto by name.
- **No verified product launches or executive hires were found in the window.**

---

## Changes in the Last 30 Days

### News and Corporate Developments

**IPO timeline reset.** The most material change is the revised listing window. In a town hall, co-founder and CEO Aadit Palicha told employees that Zepto plans to list between February and May 2027 and will update its DRHP with newer financials ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). The report states that SEBI's clearance is expected to remain valid until November 2027 ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). The article's publication date is not shown in the extract. Its sidebar lists items dated 8–11 November 2026, so it was likely published in mid-November. **This date is unverified.**

**Regulatory actions (October 2026).**
- On 12 October 2026, the Bengaluru East City Corporation fined Zepto ₹5,000 for failing to follow solid waste segregation rules. This was part of a wider commercial waste enforcement campaign ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))). This date falls just outside the 30-day window and is included for context.
- On 24 October 2026, the Uttar Pradesh Food Safety and Drug Administration suspended licences for four dark stores and warehouses run by food delivery and quick-commerce platforms. The source does not name Zepto as an operator of the affected sites. **Zepto's involvement is unverified** ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))).

### Product Launches

No verified product launch was found in the window. The Zepto Nova "Pitch in 10" programme is a supplier-onboarding initiative, not a consumer product launch. Its applications closed on 22 May 2026, with results announced on 31 July 2026 ([Startup Grants India, n.d.](https://www.startupgrantsindia.com/competitions/zepto-nova-pitch-in-10-programme)). It falls outside the window. The source page does not show the selected participants.

### Executive and Key Hires

**No verified hires or departures were identified in the window.** The only leadership reference is Aadit Palicha's town hall address to employees ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). Reuters reported that Enforcement Directorate summoned co-founders Aadit Palicha and Kaivalya Vohra in April 2026. Zepto said both complied and that no further communication had been received as of the June filing date ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). This item is outside the window and is included for risk context.

### Deals, Partnerships, and Capital

**Pre-IPO placement.** The reported round is about ₹1,000 crore (approximately $105 million) at a valuation of about $4.5 billion. Reports say the investors may include domestic institutions and existing backers General Catalyst, Goodwater Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners ([New Indian Express, 2026](https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2026/Jul/30/zepto-eyes-rs-1000-crore-pre-ipo-funding-listing-schedule-moves-back-by-weeks)). Under SEBI rules, a pre-IPO placement can be up to 20% of the proposed fresh issue, and the amount is deducted from that fresh issue ([New Indian Express, 2026](https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2026/Jul/30/zepto-eyes-rs-1000-crore-pre-ipo-funding-listing-schedule-moves-back-by-weeks)). The LinkedIn source says the round will come from domestic and overseas investors ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). **The closing status and final terms are unverified.** The placement was first reported in late July, so the timing of the change is not confirmed as new.

---

## Context: How the IPO Story Has Changed

| Date | Reported Item | Key Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dec 2025 | Confidential DRHP filing; conversion to public company | Target listing in 2026 | [Moneycontrol News, 2025](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/zepto-converts-to-a-public-company-ahead-of-planned-ipo-in-2026-13713491.html) |
| Jan 2026 | Target issue size and valuation | ₹11,000 crore (~$1.2bn) at $7–8bn | [Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026) |
| May 2026 | Reported July 2026 IPO plan | ₹11,000 crore | [PTI, 2026](http://hospitality.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/operations/technology/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-cr-ipo-in-july-2026/131255022) |
| Jun 2026 | Updated draft papers | Up to $837m; ₹8,010 crore fresh issue | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Jul 2026 | Pre-IPO round and delay | ~$4.5bn valuation | [Mint/PTI, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/zepto-to-raise-rs-1-000-crore-in-pre-ipo-round-at-usd-4-5-billion-valuation-public-listing-delayed-11785430328994.html) |
| Nov 2026 | Revised listing window | February–May 2027 | [LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc) |

Note that the Reuters article gives two different rupee amounts for the IPO. It cites "up to $837 million" and also "110 billion rupee ($1.15 billion)" ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). The reason for the gap is not explained in the source.

---

## Financial Snapshot

Reuters reports the following from the updated DRHP for the year ended 31 March 2026 ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)):

| Metric | FY26 (year ended 31 Mar 2026) | Approx. USD* |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ₹226.24 bn (more than doubled year on year) | ~$2.36 bn |
| Net loss | ₹59.05 bn (up from ₹47 bn) | ~$0.62 bn |
| Loss as % of revenue | ~26% | n/a |

*Conversions use the ₹95.7 per US dollar rate cited in the Reuters article. The rate is from June 2026 and is shown for scale only.

The loss rose faster than the revenue base in relative terms, which is consistent with the company's stated focus on reducing cash burn ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).

---

## Source Reliability and Unverified Items

| Item | Reliability Assessment | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Revised listing window (Feb–May 2027) | Single secondary source; publication date not shown | Partly verified; date unverified |
| $105m pre-IPO round | Consistent across LinkedIn, TNIE, and Mint; terms not confirmed by company | Reported, not confirmed |
| ~$4.5bn valuation | Mint and TNIE, both citing sources | Reported, not confirmed |
| UP licence suspensions | Wikipedia summary; Zepto not named | Unverified for Zepto |
| Dhan ₹11,000 crore / $7–8bn target | Dated January 2026; superseded by later reports | Outdated |
| ETHospitalityWorld article | URL domain differs from title source | Verify before external use |
| Zepto Nova results | Programme page shows no results content | Unverified |

---

## Our Assessment

Based on the available evidence, we hold three views.

1. **The valuation reset is the central issue.** The reported ~$4.5 billion pre-IPO valuation is about 36% below the $7 billion valuation Reuters cites for Zepto's October 2025 round ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). If that figure holds, the company's listing will need to be priced against a lower mark than the one it previously sought. This matters for existing investors, and it is a more significant change than the timing slip alone.

2. **The company is prioritising capital discipline over speed to market.** The delay, the bridge round, and the stated plan to curtail burn and optimise dark stores all point the same way ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). With FY26 losses of ₹59.05 billion, that approach is reasonable. The unresolved question is whether cost cuts can reduce losses fast enough to support the February–May 2027 window.

3. **The timeline has more room than it did.** SEBI clearance is reported to remain valid until November 2027 ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). That gives Zepto roughly twelve months to list, which reduces the risk of a forced listing at a weak price. It also means the company could face further delays if markets or its financials weaken.

Regulatory exposure is a secondary but real concern. The Bengaluru fine is small in value, but the pattern of municipal and state-level actions is relevant to a listing-stage disclosure exercise.

---

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **What are the terms and status of the pre-IPO round?** Please confirm the amount, valuation, investor mix, and whether the round has closed. Also clarify how the valuation reset will be reflected in the IPO price range and in the updated DRHP.

2. **What burn-reduction targets and timelines apply to the February–May 2027 window?** Please share specific goals for net loss, cash burn, and dark store count. Also explain which stores or sites are being optimised and whether any closures are linked to the recent regulatory actions.

3. **How are the regulatory matters being disclosed and resolved?** Please confirm the status of the Enforcement Directorate inquiry, the October municipal and state-level actions, and whether any of them will be disclosed as risk factors in the updated DRHP.

---
